title: 第9章 同辈切磋第10章 大哥叶飞扬
content_zh:
在叶非凡原本的计划中，他会在这个检验大会上，受尽嘲讽侮辱，然后自己回去后气愤不已，发誓要让现在看不起自己的人在以后高攀不起，此后，会有天降老爷爷（大姐姐也可以），给自己送上无上秘法或者教自己特殊的技能或者职业，默默修炼后崛起，君临辉月城，完成装逼打脸。
当然这也不能说是他的计划，只能说叶非凡以前看过的很多小说都是这个套路，让他习惯性的以为自己穿越后也会是这个发展，甚至可以说叶非凡熟读多年网络小说套路，在穿越后他把这个当作是自己的优势之一。
但显然，事情并没有像他想象中的那般发展。
尽管家族检验大会上，当自己的练气4重修为公布后，还是有几个人对这件事情嘲讽了一番，但力度实在是太轻了，叶非凡不仅不生气，甚至有点想笑。
这情况下，还怎么分配老爷爷（大姐姐）啊，强行分配，最为致命。
“四弟，看你脸色，有点不高兴啊，怎么了，是因为刚刚有人嘲讽辱骂你吗？“
“没有没有，我这修为，被大家议论几句很正常，而且大家也都说的有道理，身为嫡系的我还得加倍努力赶上大家“叶非凡赶紧堆起笑脸。
正在此时，台上的叶豹长老说道。
“接下来就是切磋环节，大家有没有想挑战的，可以现在就上台来，咱们修炼者，不仅要埋头修炼，也要多多与同辈人切磋，在切磋中吸取经验，才能让自己的修为更上一层楼，毕竟，资源都是争出来的。“
“不过我要说明一下，不到练气6重的就先不要上来了，术法和武技都没多少，无法很好的进行比试。“
听着台上的话，大家都在思考，本次6重以下的不参加，而顶端的叶飞扬和叶兴怀他们实力太强，没人打的过，只有他们2人之间可以互相切磋下，那剩下的就是6~8重之间的同辈门切磋。
此时，一人跳上台中，拱手道。
“白展堂，练气7重，希望可以与叶洪进行切磋。“
台下另一人听闻后，立即走上台中。
“叶洪，练气7重，愿意进行切磋。“
叶豹听闻，点了点头，便示意他们开始。
只见白展堂快速向叶洪冲去，直接右手握拳，击向对方面庞。
叶洪丝毫不惧，微微侧身，躲过白展堂的直拳，然后一个回旋侧踢，意图踢向白展堂腰间。
“横扫千军“
这是已经使用了武技，同时灵力释放，伴随着腿劲，气势不低。

而白展堂见一击不中，立即后跳退开，并且也使用武技，意图与叶洪硬碰硬。
“野球拳“
随即灵气喷涌而出。
“砰。“
双方灵气的碰撞传出剧烈的响声，而叶洪似乎有所不及，往后退了好几步，而白展堂见此更是打算乘胜追击，继续使用野球拳向叶洪冲去。
叶洪见状，连忙向旁边闪去，并使用武技‘旋风腿‘开始围绕演武场进行各种移动。
而白展堂见久攻不下，便不再使用野球拳，自知无法跟上叶洪的速度，并站在原地，时刻关注叶洪的动向。
叶洪见此，便通借助‘旋风腿‘的灵活性，不时绕道白展堂的侧后方使用‘横扫千军’进行攻击。
眼见白展堂落入下风，只能被动防守，甚至硬接了几下‘横扫千军’，幸好练气7重已经可以做到一定的灵气护体，才不至于直接受到重创。
似乎胜者已经显而易见。
突然，只听见一声大喝
content_en:
In Ye Feifan's original plan, he would be ridiculed and humiliated in this inspection conference, and then he would be very angry when he went back, vowing to make those who look down on him now unable to reach him in the future. After that, a grandfather (big sister can also be used) would descend from the sky, give him a supreme secret method or teach him a special skill or profession, practice silently, rise up, and come to Huiyue City to complete the pretense and slap in the face.
Of course, this cannot be said to be his plan. It can only be said that many novels that Ye Fan has read before have this routine, which makes him habitually think that he will develop like this after time travel. It can even be said that Ye Fan has been familiar with the routines of online novels for many years. After time traveling, he regarded this as one of his advantages.
But obviously, things did not develop as he imagined.
Although at the family inspection meeting, when his fourth level of Qi training was announced, several people still laughed at the matter, but the intensity was too light. Not only was Ye Feifan not angry, he even wanted to laugh.
In this case, how can we allocate the grandfather (eldest sister)? Forced allocation is the most fatal.
"Fourth brother, looking at your face, you look a little unhappy. What's wrong? Is it because someone just mocked and insulted you?"
"No, no, with my cultivation level, it's normal for everyone to talk about it, and everyone's opinions are reasonable. As a direct descendant, I have to work harder to catch up with everyone." Ye Feifan quickly put on a smile.
At this moment, Elder Ye Bao on the stage said.
"The next step is the competition session. If you want to challenge, you can come on stage now. We cultivators should not only immerse ourselves in cultivation, but also compete with our peers. Only by gaining experience from the competition can we take our cultivation to the next level. After all, resources are all earned through competition."
"But I want to explain, if you are not at the sixth level of Qi training, don't come up yet. There are not many techniques and martial arts, so you can't compete well."
Listening to the words on the stage, everyone was thinking that people below the 6th level will not participate this time, and Ye Feiyang and Ye Xinghuai at the top are too strong and no one can beat them. Only the two of them can compete with each other, and the rest is between peers between 6th and 8th level.
At this time, a man jumped onto Taichung and held his hands.
"Bai Zhantang, qi training level 7, hopes to compete with Ye Hong."
After hearing this, another person in the audience immediately walked to Taichung.
"Ye Hong, Qi training level 7, is willing to compete."
Ye Bao heard this, nodded, and signaled them to start.
Bai Zhantang was seen rushing towards Ye Hong quickly, making a fist with his right hand and hitting the opponent's face.
Ye Hong was not afraid at all. He turned slightly to avoid Bai Zhantang's straight punch, and then performed a roundhouse side kick with the intention of hitting Bai Zhantang's waist.
"Sweeping thousands of armies"
This is a martial art that has been used, and at the same time spiritual power is released. Along with the leg strength, the momentum is not low.
Seeing that Bai Zhantang missed the hit, he immediately jumped back and used martial arts, intending to confront Ye Hong head-on.
"Wild Ball Boxing"
Immediately, spiritual energy spurted out.
"Bang."
The collision of auras between the two sides made a violent sound, but Ye Hong seemed to be a little behind and took several steps back. Seeing this, Bai Zhantang planned to pursue the victory and continued to use the wild ball fist to rush towards Ye Hong.
Seeing this, Ye Hong quickly dodged to the side and used the martial arts skill 'Tornado Kick' to start various movements around the martial arts arena.
When Bai Zhantang saw that he could not attack for a long time, he stopped using the wild ball fist. He knew that he could not keep up with Ye Hong's speed, and stood there, always paying attention to Ye Hong's movements.
Seeing this, Ye Hong used the flexibility of his 'Tornado Legs' to attack Bai Zhantang from time to time by going around the side and behind him and using 'Sweeping Thousands of Troops'.
Seeing that Bai Zhantang was at a disadvantage, he could only defend passively, and even received a few "sweeping armies" forcefully. Fortunately, the 7th level of Qi training was able to achieve a certain amount of spiritual energy protection, so that he would not be directly hit hard.
